comment: Required fixtures and explicit exclusions for Parts 4-7, defined in Part 2 before any decompiler change. Requirements may be added or tightened; removing or weakening one requires a recorded user decision in docs/DECISIONS.md. Checked mechanically by: harness/difftest.py gate --part N RESULTS.json

decoding.comment: Mechanized in Part 4 (the four former not_yet_mechanized items): difftest.py gate --decoding DIR reads the reports of harness/tools/decoding_check.py. Every pycdas run and reference run happens in the harness sandbox. Versions extend beyond required_versions, which only tightens the original items.

dis.means: pycdas output equals the same interpreter's marshal/dis decoding at the semantic level: code-object fields, names, local/cell/free names, constants (exact values, including signed zeros, NaN, non-ASCII and surrogate strings), every instruction (offset with EXTENDED_ARG folded, opcode, raw operand, and the resolved jump target, name, constant, local or comparison) and the exception table

headers.means: checked-hash and unchecked-hash .pyc files, as py_compile writes them, give pycdas and pycdc results identical to the timestamp-based .pyc

formats.means: pycdas and pycdc exit nonzero with a message on stderr, without a crash or timeout, and print nothing that looks like a successful listing (no '(Python -1.-1)', no '<NULL>')

malformed.means: deterministic truncations and seeded byte mutations of every required .pyc: pycdas never crashes, hangs or hits the output limit on any version; pycdc never does on 3.13 and 3.14. pycdc crashes on 3.10-3.12 are reported and must not increase relative to the pre-Part-4 build

5.title: Recover expressions, calls, functions, and classes

6.title: Recover structured control flow and exceptions

7.title: Cover modern language features and interactions

always: no regression against the frozen baseline in any suite, version or optimization level (difftest.py compare exits 0)
no MISSING interpreter and no HARNESS_ERROR in the results
difftest.py controls reports 0 unexpected control outcomes
upstream token-level suite (reports/part1-baseline/per_file_outcomes.py): no compiled/*.pyc that passed at baseline fails

exclusions.what: source fidelity: comments, formatting, blank lines, choice among equivalent syntax, names of compiler temporaries
exclusions.why: not recoverable from bytecode in general; out of the mission (docs/ROADMAP.md scope)

exclusions.what: everything outside the observation contract in harness/README.md: tracebacks, line/column numbers, code-object attributes, object identity, compile-time warnings, timing

exclusions.why: absent from the compiled program; behavior comparison already accounts for this
covered only by upstream's token-level suite, which must not regress
outside the initial scope unless separately approved

exclusions.what: Cython/Nuitka binaries, packaging extraction, obfuscated bytecode
marshalled code objects loaded with pycdc -c -v X.Y
exclusions.why: not in the initial matrix; existing behavior must not regress
not authored/reviewed fixtures; compiled and decompiled only
